## Ingredients
- 200 g of corn flour
- 80 g of salted anchovies
- 3 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste frying oil
- to taste black pepper
## Method
1. Prepare the polenta and turn it out onto a baking sheet; level it with a wet spatula, forming a layer of 1,5 cm, and let it cool.
2. Clean the anchovies, desalt them, dry them, and melt them in hot oil.
3. Cut the now cold polenta into small squares of about 5 cm on a side and fry them in hot oil for a few minutes, a few at a time.
4. Drain them, place them on paper towels, turning them once.
5. Spread them with the anchovy cream and serve them still hot.
